figurative_meaning_en: to walk unsteadily or staggering from side to side
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মদ খেয়ে রাস্তায় ঝিঁকে মারা চলছে।
বুড়ো মানুষটি বয়সের কারণে ঝিঁকে মারা হাঁটছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is staggering along the street after drinking alcohol.
The old man is walking unsteadily due to his age.
note: This idiom often implies drunkenness or physical infirmity in everyday Bengali conversation.
